incidents.name: SumerMoney
incidents.notes: reentrancy in repayBorrowBehalf inflated cToken exchangeRate before totalBorrows decreased

sources.ref: onchain review: the victim's executing code is immutable - zero DELEGATECALL opcodes in the deployed runtime and an identical codehash at the creation block and the incident block - so the deployment basis is an exact measurement, not an upper bound; nonStandardUpgradeArchitecture removed accordingly

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0x23811c17bac40500decd5fb92d4feb972ae1e607 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x7b5969bb51fa3b002579d7ee41a454ac691716dc, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (7412888s -> 7412878s)
